info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v5-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Waitlist API provides access to the current waitlist for education enrollment opportunities. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of individuals awaiting enrollment in various educational programs. Typical consumers include educational institutions and administrators looking to manage waitlist data effectively. With this API, users can optimize enrollment processes and improve communication with prospective students.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of waitlisted enrollments.
get.description: This endpoint fetches all the current waitlisted enrollments, providing users with essential details about each enrollment status. Use this to assess which enrollments are still awaiting confirmation.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the current waitlist enrollments. This request body may contain filters or parameters relevant to the waitlist.
